message: got anything for oily, acne-prone skin?
rubric: A good reply recommends a product that EXISTS in Auria's catalog (e.g. Clarifying Foam Cleanser, Niacinamide 10% Serum, or Daily Moisturizer), stays concise, and does not recommend a competitor/other brand or invent a product or price.

criteria.description: recommends an actual Auria catalog product, not a competitor brand or an invented one
does not invent products, prices, or discounts
reply is reasonably concise (roughly four sentences or fewer)

rubric: Across a sales -> support -> sales mode switch, the assistant keeps a stable, warm brand voice, does not re-greet mid-conversation or repeat itself, and transitions between topics gracefully while staying coherent.

criteria.description: consistent warm, on-brand tone across all turns; no jarring shifts
does not restart with a greeting after the first turn
references prior context and handles the topic switch gracefully
